definitions.explanation: Power derived from the force or movement of water, especially when used for generating electricity.

examples.japanese: {水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Hydroelectric power is a renewable energy source.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To generate hydroelectric power using a dam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山地|さんち}→山地：12647_sanchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適|てき}している→適する：02297_tekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has many mountainous areas and is suitable for hydroelectric power.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {水|すい} (water) + {力|りょく} (power). Literally "water power."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (hydroelectric power generation)
・{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電所|はつでんしょ}→発電所：15991_hatsudensho⟧ (hydroelectric power plant)
・{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電機|はつでんき}→発電機：29732_hatsudenki⟧ (hydroelectric generator)
・⟦{小|しょう}→小：noentry⟧{水力|すいりょく}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (small-scale hydropower)
・⟦{揚水|ようすい}→揚水：noentry⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (pumped-storage power generation)

TYPES OF HYDROPOWER:
・⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧ (dam-based)
・⟦{水路|すいろ}→水路：13264_suiro⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧ (run-of-river)
・⟦{揚水|ようすい}→揚水：noentry⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧ (pumped-storage)

JAPAN CONTEXT: Japan developed many hydropower plants during the early 20th century. Famous examples include ⟦{黒部|くろべ}→黒部：noentry⟧⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧ (Kurobe Dam).

・⟦{風力|ふうりょく}→風力：06432_fuuryoku⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (wind power generation)
・⟦{原子力|げんしりょく}→原子力：06433_genshiryoku⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (nuclear power generation)
・⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}→太陽光：06209_taiyoukou⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧ (solar power generation)
